mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 6.0% signals tightening labor market conditions, which increases corporate wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to higher equity risk premiums and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 6.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.25% over a 3-month window signals the start of a monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates on future equity cash flows and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction starts (HOUST) and personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand growth, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 103.0 over two consecutive months indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which signals deteriorating corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and demand momentum, which drives corporate earnings growth and results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 0.5% MoM and HOUST increases > 1.0% MoM in the same month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which increases consumer spending and inflationary pressure, leading to higher equity risk premiums and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.0% year-over-year, combined with a stable federal funds rate, signals inflationary pressures that prompt the Fed to delay rate cuts, increasing real rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 2.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.5% annualized rate, combined with rising residential construction (HOUST), indicates strong economic momentum that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 2.5% annualized and HOUST > 1000.0 (thousands) in the same quarter
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
